text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PDR-20260314-AGG - canary-eu-probe (ci-eu-01) reporting 5xx rate 32% over 5m window
pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR-20260314-AGG created -> https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PDR-20260314-AGG
maria (oncall): ack - taking lead. quick triage: canary-eu failing, other regions look healthy. i'll coordinate mitigations and keep PD updated. :white_check_mark:
tom (sre): on the logs now. temp checks show connection resets + token failures from prober pods.
jordan (platform): i see a burst of prober restarts starting ~21:03 UTC. spike in token refresh 401s in the last 6m. could be secret rotation mismatch.
alex (eng-runtime): noted. i rolled a small rollback of the new kernel selection on the prober image earlier today — will prepare a rollback if needed.
maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable eu canary fanout to stop repeat pages, 2) scale prober-eu to absorb retries, 3) check secrets and rollout, 4) restart pods. doing 1 & 2 now.
---
# commands run
maria (oncall): `kubectl patch configmap/canary-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"eu":{"enabled":false}}'`
maria (oncall): `kubectl scale deployment/prober-eu -n probes --replicas=10`
---
tom (sre): logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-14T21:05:31Z prober-eu-1 ERROR http 502 target/healthcheck failed: connection reset by peer
2026-03-14T21:05:33Z prober-eu-2 WARN token refresh failed 401 "invalid_client"
2026-03-14T21:05:40Z prober-eu-3 INFO restart backoff
```
jordan (platform): confirmed: secret probes/eu-prober-token shows lastRotation=2026-03-14T20:58Z. some prober pods still using cached token. i'll push a secret re-sync and patch pods to pick up new secret.
alex (eng-runtime): i'm preparing to switch prober image back to prober:v1.3.3 (removes kernel-opt). will push image patch in next 2m.
maria (oncall): customer impact assessment: no direct customer-facing 5xx on API gateways observed. Impact limited to internal synthetic checks and downstream batch jobs in EU that rely on canary metrics — possible delayed alerts. severity: P2. ETA for full mitigation: ~30-45m. notifying CS.
eve (cust-suc): noted. flagging top eu customers: draft email posted to #customer-updates -> please review before I send.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by maria (oncall) at 3467890200
tom (sre): performing rolling restart to force secret refresh: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prober-eu -n probes`
jordan (platform): secret re-applied: `kubectl apply -f eu-prober-secret.yaml -n probes` -> new token in place. watching pod env / mounted secret timestamps.
alex (eng-runtime): image rollback deployed: prober:v1.3.3 -> applied to prober-eu deployment.
maria (oncall): verification check: 5xx dropping — current 5xx rate 3% over 5m. keeping suppressed pages for now. i'll monitor for 15m and then re-enable canary.
incident-bot: Canary alert suppression engaged for eu for 10m by maria (manual)
jordan (platform): followup: rotated the k8s secret and confirmed all prober pods now show secret checksum label `checksum/prober-secret:sha256:abcd1234`
tom (sre): summary for handoff: probable root cause = secret rotation mismatch + prober pods holding cached tokens; contributing factor = image kernel-opt causing faster restarts under token errors. recovery actions: 1) rotate and reapply secret, 2) rollout restart prober-eu, 3) rollback kernel-opt image, 4) temporarily disable canary fanout to eu, 5) scale prober during remediation.
maria (oncall): i'll keep PD open until stable for 30m. notes to postmortem: include timeline, secret rotation automation, add a preflight check to ensure prober secret sync across pods, and add alert that ties token-refresh 401 trend to paging thresholds.
tom (sre): will stay on until metrics stable. i'll draft the postmortem skeleton in #postmortems tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
maria (oncall): thanks everyone, great coordination. closing thread here, will update PD on resolution once we hit the 30m stability window. :white_check_mark:
